description: Start a test script generation workflow. It records at one of the test case's runSettings records, whose resolutions muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-update sets; pass runSettingsId to pick the record. Anything the test must or must not touch, including which target and which path, goes in the test case's stored description before the run. A limit stated only in chat with the coding agent does not reach the run.

instructions.description: Text for this run. It adds to the test case's stored description, which always reaches the run, and never replaces it.

runEnvironmentType.description: Environment lane for the run: 'local' (developer localhost) or 'remote' (deployed). Selects which versioned runSettings/credentials lane the cloud resolves. Omit for remote (default).

runSettingsId.description: The test case's runSettings record to record against, from runSettingsList of muggle-remote-test-case-display-resolutions-get. Omitted, the run records at the test case's primary record, except that a test case with a prerequisite records at its parent's record.

workflowParams.description: Optional workflow parameters for workflow-level overrides

llm.description: Model tier override. tier 'light' runs the Standard tier (Claude Sonnet 5.5, faster and lower cost); tier 'standard' runs the Premium tier (Claude Opus 5.5, the default). Omit to inherit the project/use case/test case setting.

maxRunTimeMs.description: Max runtime per workflow kind, in milliseconds (60000–3600000). The run fails as timed out once it exceeds this. Omit a kind to inherit the project/use case/test case setting, else its built-in limit.

enableEverMemOS.description: Override to enable/disable EverMemOS for this workflow run

enableSharedTestMemory.description: Override to enable/disable SharedTestMemory for this workflow run

name: muggle-remote-workflow-start-test-script-generation
